text_simplified: Justice among children is a foundational principle in tarbiyah. If one of them needs special care—due to illness, absence for study, work, or treatment—the parents must explain to the rest of the children the reason for this distinction in treatment, so that no feeling of injustice or jealousy takes root in their hearts.
